result.title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
result.summary: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

AI.brief_summary: PartiCam 提出一种免训练的粒子滤波式奖励引导方法，用全局-局部精化框架（基于 SMC 引导与粒子滤波重采样）改进相机轨迹控制的视频扩散生成，减少漂移并提升视觉质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 视频生成任务本身不在主线，但其粒子滤波、重采样与全局-局部精化的采样机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设维持、探索-坍缩权衡与推理停止/证据筛选提供可核查的类比线索。
